title: Screenshot tests, CI gating, and docs
description: KANBUS_TEST_SCREENSHOT_MOCK for mocked capture in default CI; gate @slow live-browser scenario. Document browser install path in README or CLI help. Parity across Python and Rust.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text:
CI on PR #171 failed for three reasons, all fixable without rewriting screenshot:

1. **python**: black wants `console_screenshot.py` and `console_screenshot_steps.py` reformatted
2. **rust**: rustfmt diffs in `cli.rs`, `console_screenshot.rs`, `lib.rs`, screenshot steps
3. **python-console-parity**: `@slow` live capture ran because it is also tagged `@console-server`. Rust cucumber already skips `@slow`. Align the Python parity job to `not @slow` so CI does not require Playwright Chromium.

Merging origin/develop first (wiki, Dependabot, rust AI-mock serialize).

comments.text: Shipped on main in kanbus 0.24.1 (PR #178). Epic kbs-8de39f already closed; closing leftover child task.
